title: A new classmate
text: Mike Brown: Hello, I’m Mike Brown.
Yang Ling: Hi, Mike. I’m Yang Ling.
Mike Brown: Nice to meet you, Yang Ling.
Yang Ling: Nice to meet you too.
Mike Brown: Hello. What’s your name?
Liu Tao: My name is Liu Tao.
Wang Bing: I’m Wang Bing. Nice to meet you.
Tip: Note English names. See page 76.
sentences: Nice to meet you, Yang Ling.
